title: Antes de que y después de que: asimetrías modales
goal: Master the syntactic asymmetry between 'antes de que' (obligatory subjunctive) and 'después de que' (indicative vs subjunctive).
grammar: Anterioridad y posterioridad temporal: antes de que y después de que

sections.title: Unit 7: Temporal Subordination — Lesson 5
body: Welcome to lesson 5 of Unit 7 (Temporal Subordination & Future Prospections). Mastering the boundary between indicative and subjunctive in temporal clauses is a hallmark of upper-intermediate fluency.
In this lesson, we analyze antes de que y después de que: asimetrías modales, establishing precise temporal coordination across complex sentences.

items: Master the syntactic asymmetry between 'antes de que' (obligatory subjunctive) and 'después de que' (indicative vs subjunctive).
Incorporate advanced temporal vocabulary (la anterioridad, la posterioridad).
